scope.comparison: One selected delivery segment per candidate; independent of any city map dataset.
scope.sourceStatus: public authority context plus sample attestations
scope.unsupported: Operator licensing and permits, collisions, local signs beyond the selected candidate, parking, tolls, weather, worker classification and transport hours regulations.

nycTruck.title: Truck Route Network
nycTruck.basis: Local and through network, nearest off-network destination connection, non-truck distinction.

nycBike.title: Delivery by Bike or E-Bike
nycBike.basis: Administrative Code §§10-157 and 10-157.1 delivery worker course, equipment and identification requirements.

londonOxford.title: Oxford Street rules and exemptions
londonOxford.basis: Traffic-free section, delivery and servicing access hours and approved servicing routes, cycle restriction, emergency exemption.

londonCycle.title: The Highway Code, rules 62–64
londonCycle.basis: Do not cycle on pavement; distinguish from areas designated for cycling or verified shared tracks.
